title: Add SettingsPanelView: full-window settings shell + General tab
description: The settings surface itself: a full-window panel with a category sidebar and a detail pane, drawn entirely with the skin primitives so it's a live preview of the active look. This first cut is the shell plus a working General tab (Advanced Mode, UI Size, sample games); the other tabs are added on top one at a time.
